rules.synth: one A-rank synth comp per live tribe that had zero kept comps, pieces from current in_pool only

summary.synth_note: v2 playable synths: real archetypes with playbooks; NO Tier-7 cores/keys/boards; Aberrations Discard Engine, Dragons Rally Poet (non-Evoker), Elementals Unbound Tempest, Mechs Glambot Magnetics, Quilboar Choose One Gems. Kept snapshot comps unchanged. NOT trained.

synth_comps_with_boards.name: Aberrations - Discard Engine
synth_comps_with_boards.playbook: Aberrations win early–mid by discarding fodder to pump your Deity and board, then often pivot rather than forcing a pure late Aberration endgame. Key enablers: Activate discard pieces (Zoatroid, Abyssal Envoy, Mindbending Recruiter) plus hand generators; Blood Gems are excellent discard fuel. Mindbender Ghur'sha is the board-wide payoff on every discard; Cutthroat K'Thir and Harbinger Aph'lass stack Deity/self stats; The Shadow of Doubt scales whenever cards enter hand. Turn plan: keep a discard Activate ready, generate cheap cards/spells, discard into Mindbender Ghur'sha/Cutthroat K'Thir/Harbinger Aph'lass, and improve spell power with Dark Puppeteer / N'raqi Frostcaller. Late: Parasitic Fleshling and Mysterious K'Thir convert total discards/spells into stats; De-volition-ist is the attack finisher. Do not plan around Tier-7.
synth_comps_with_boards.notes: Real discard/Deity engine (not top-tier sort). Meta: early–mid launchpad; Blood Gems = discard fodder; no T7.

synth_comps_with_boards.name: Dragons - Rally Poet
synth_comps_with_boards.playbook: Classic Dragons APM Evoker is dead this lobby (Fire-Forged Evoker / key discover pieces out of pool) — play Rally + permanent-keyword dragons instead. Park Persistent Poet beside your carry (Crimson Vindicator or Scarlet Survivor/Tarecgosa) so combat keywords and stats stick forever; Amber Guardian attaches permanent Divine Shield through Poet. Hunt Chromadrake generators (Draconic Warden, Bronze Timewalker, Hired Mount) and Sky-hatch Runaway to force Rally triggers on demand; Crimson Vindicator's Rally casts Mighty Dragonbreath for the combat spike. Kalecgos, Arcane Aspect (+ Brann Bronzebeard if available) rewards battlecry cycling (Draconic Warden, Tavern Tempest, Firescale Hoarder). Felfire Conjurer / Firescale Hoarder drip permanent tavern-spell buffs. Do not draft around Tier-7 Obsidian Ravager.
synth_comps_with_boards.notes: Non-Evoker rebuild: Permanent Poet + Rally Chromadrake from in-pool pieces. Evoker keys out of pool. No T7.

synth_comps_with_boards.name: Elementals - Unbound Tempest
synth_comps_with_boards.playbook: Elementals Unbound Tempest is still the scaling plan: buff the shop, then feed Unbound Tempest the highest-Health tavern minion every three Elementals played. Nomi is out of pool — Air Revenant (Easterly Winds after gold) and En-Djinn Blazer / Waveling refresh buffs are the shop enablers. Economy engine: Brann Bronzebeard + Tavern Tempest + Kelp Keeper to chain Elemental battlecries and stay infinite; cycle Sellemental, Refreshing Anomaly, and Ballers. Flaming Enforcer stabilizes mid by consuming tavern Health; Flourishing Frostling is a passive payoff for Elementals played this game; Elemental of Surprise helps triple awkwardly. Do not plan around Tier-7 Stone Age Slab.
synth_comps_with_boards.notes: Classic Unbound Tempest shop-scaling without Nomi/out-of-pool keys; Air Revenant is the shop buffer. No T7.

synth_comps_with_boards.name: Mechs - Glambot Magnetics
synth_comps_with_boards.playbook: Mechs Magnetics/Spells: while Glambot is on board, every spell cast on a Mech Magnetizes a Satellite; Balinda Stonehearth doubles targeted friendly spells so you attach twice as often. Spark Snapper improves Satellite size whenever you play Mechs (Scrap Scraper is out — Snapper is the generation core). Drone Duplicator Activate makes the next Magnetize happen an extra time. Endgame Utility Drone pays +4/+5 per Magnetization at end of turn — that is the win condition. Charging Czarina spikes Divine Shield mechs when you cast spells. Turn plan: buy 1–2 cost targeted spells / Fearless Foodie / Gearfin spell gen, cast onto mechs, Activate Duplicator on the best Magnetize, then land Utility Drone. Optional deathrattle line: Falling Sky Golem + Titus Rivendare if magnetics are slow. No Tier-7 Polarizing Beatboxer.
synth_comps_with_boards.notes: Rebuild of Magnetics/Spells without Scrap Scraper / Beatboxer; Glambot+Snapper+Utility Drone+Balinda. No T7.

synth_comps_with_boards.name: Quilboar - Choose One Gems
synth_comps_with_boards.playbook: Quilboar Choose One: scale Blood Gem quality first (Gem Rat's Gem Day, Fearless Foodie +1/+1 choose, Sanguine Refiner Rally, Sanguine Champion battlecry/deathrattle), then pay off with Turbo Hogrider. Every Choose One you play makes Turbo Hogrider blood-gem all other Quilboar — generate Choose Ones via Bramble Tunneler, Gem Rat, Snare Trapper, Crater Miner; Thorned Trailblazer combines both Choose effects. Veteran Brigand is the late Choose One bomb (gems everyone or triple Barrage). Trench Fighter's Gem Confiscation concentrates gems onto one unit when you need a carry. Meta: Quilboar are often support (Blood Gems for spell-on-minion comps or Aberration discard fodder) — force pure Quilboar when the lobby is soft or you hit Hogrider + gem quality early. No Tier-7 Jailbird Juggernaut; Vigilant Bristlemane is out of pool.
synth_comps_with_boards.notes: Choose One quilboar without Vigilant Bristlemane / Jailbird T7; Turbo Hogrider + gem quality + Choose One generation.
